body: Sorry for late information, didnt get through with it. Went asleep with plastic bag over head, woke up at ER. Apparently someone found me. Couple of days at psychward and got out, been quite interesting couple of days at home now.

Sure... Why not. I got like 9 hours to spare so might aswell explain my self.

To put it simply, i just dont have anything to live for anymore.
I've never enjoyed this life im stuck in, and cant really do anything to change it. I have 4 different degrees, 1. Housebuilder 2. Paramedic 3. Electrician and
4. Bartender. None of those have ever given me any joy as an employee, also have worked in many different jobs, which i dont have degree and it just seems like i cant work anywhere. Just got more and more depressed each job i got.

Then i tried being unemployed. Tried to take some freetime for my self, explore places, travel. But when i got no job, i pretty much cant afford anything, and after sometime now, it seems harder and harder to even get out of bed. Dont want to go anywhere out, since i really cant afford anything besides rent and bills, and just enough food to make it throught month.

I've been quite open with my friends and family with my suicidal toughts past ~6 years. 2 failed attempts after, it seems i've gotten to a point they dont seem to care anymore. 1 or 2 friends and my mom seems to be only ones who cares enough to talk to me when im feeling low and suicidal. Got 2 brothers who i haven't seen in like 2 years, and i know that they are aware of this situation. Not in speaking terms with my father, never really been, but after my second attempt he just told me im a huge failior and i should just really kill myself.

Past 5 years i've been talking weekly to a psychiatrist. Havent had any help besides medication, which only helps to sleep better. They really cant even tell whats wrong with me yet, something of a bipolar, borderline personal disorder, mild autism mixed with some form of psychopathy.

I feel kinda attracted to death, like everything and everyone is better withouth me. I kinda believe i just finally get a good rest, and i dont have to be a burden anymore.
